subject: RE: Migration of reporting service to Kubernetes
body_text: Understood. Migration postponed until September 5 while memory issues are investigated. De : Antoine JAUMOUILLE <demo.auxilium@outlook.com> Envoyé : lundi 1 juin 2026 17:30 À : Antoine JAUMOUILLE <auxilium.tuto@outlook.com> Objet : RE: Migration of reporting service to Kubernetes   Hi Emma, The migration should be postponed. Load testing revealed memory spikes exceeding 5 GB per pod. Daniel De : Antoine JAUMOUILLE <auxilium.tuto@outlook.com> Envoyé : lundi 1 juin 2026 19:30 À : demo.auxilium@outlook.com <demo.auxilium@outlook.com> Objet : Migration of reporting service to Kubernetes   Hi team, We plan to migrate the reporting service from Docker Compose to Kubernetes next month. Target migration date: August 12. Emma
